senses.gloss: m., pl. רְעָפִים, רְעָפִין (רעף, cmp. רצף, to press, flatten)

units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 8:5:8">Y. Ber. VIII, 12ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>זימן לו הקב״ה שני ר׳ וכ׳</he> the Lord made him (Adam) find two flints which he struck against each other and produced fire; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 11:2">Gen. R. s. 11</cite>; s. 12; s. 82.

<cite ref="Mishnah Beitzah 4:7">Bets. IV, 7</cite> (<cite ref="Beitzah 33a:9">33ᵃ</cite>) <he>אין מוציאין את האור … ולא מן הר׳</he> Bab. ed. (absent in Mish. a. Y. ed.) you must not produce fire (on the Holy Day) from wood … or from flints.

senses.gloss: glazed tiles. Ib. אין … את הר׳, v. לָבַן II.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Menachot 5:9">Men. V, 9</cite> <he>מאפה ר׳</he> what is baked on hot tiles; <cite ref="Tosefta Menahot 7:20">Tosef. ib. VII, 20</cite> <he>עשאן … ובר׳</he> if he baked them in a brazier or on tiles; a. e.
